text: Currently there are a number of planning studies of the Danforth underway- one from Coxwell to Victoria Park as well as one transit related study for main and Danforth. In 2019 the section form Coxwell to Broadview is to be considered for a study by City Planning. There is also the Master Planning for the new police station at Coxwell and Danforth in 2019 as well as a proposed corridor study for the entire avenue which is to begin in 2019. Two of the 5 Business Improvement Area's also have a streetscape study underway. Economic Development has a city wide retail study underway which will include the 5 Business Improvement Areas on the over 7 kilometre stretch of the Danforth The many studies underway could be brought together within an overarching concept - that of making Danforth an even greater street.
